provenance: Compiled 20 October 2026 at publication from the package's novelty_report.md and the retained internal review records. Searches listed are those recorded in that report; no new searches were run at publication. This record documents the scrutiny performed, not historical priority.

contributionMap.claim: Conjecture 1 of Dorsman and Gardner fails for every cap w >= 2: the balanced states of C_{2w+1} form a closed class of height w+1, recurrent under positive rates (Theorem 4.1).

searches.query: pass-and-swap queue swapping limit / bounded swaps Dorsman Gardner conjecture

contributionMap.closestPriorWork: Dorsman and Gardner 2024, Section 5.2.2 (states the conjecture, reports numerical support) and Appendix C.2; no later resolution found.

contributionMap.claim: Cycle classification: under positive rates C_n has a recurrent class of excessive height iff n = 1 (mod 2w), and it is unique (Theorem 5.2).
contributionMap.closestPriorWork: None on capped pass-and-swap; cyclic rotation of binary words is classical (Reiner-Stanton-White 2004).

contributionMap.claim: Positive result: bipartite swapping graphs with odd caps satisfy the conjecture under positive rates (Theorem 7.1).
contributionMap.closestPriorWork: Dorsman and Gardner 2024 Appendix C.2 remark that a proof would be easy with positive rates at all times, and their worked path examples at w = 1; no general proof found.

contributionMap.claim: Binding-move lemma and identification of capped service with truncated promotion on linear extensions (Lemma 3.3, Proposition 3.5).

limitationTriage.limitation: Even caps on bipartite graphs (Conjecture 7.2) are not proved.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the good-edge potential argument of Theorem 7.1 extend to even w?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: The proof's parity step fails for even w; exact computation on all connected bipartite graphs with at most 9 vertices and structured graphs up to 12 vertices found no counterexample.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Requires a new argument; possible traps at configurations where every longest path has exactly w+1 edges could not be excluded.

limitationTriage.limitation: Head-only (general order-independent) service is certified only for bipartite graphs with at most 7 vertices.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can transience be proved without positive rates at every position?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Full-state computation for n <= 7; closure results (Remark 4.3) hold for every rate function.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Without (PR) states with one orientation need not communicate, so the orientation-digraph reduction is unavailable.

limitationTriage.limitation: No characterisation of all (G, w) with a recurrent class of excessive height.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a criterion in terms of closed walks / odd cycles and w?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Cycle classification and two-cycle family proved; census to 7 vertices; observed 4r-orientation classes on G(a,b,L).
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: The census patterns are observations only.

limitationTriage.limitation: Heterogeneous stationary law on the balanced class has no closed form; Theorem 8.4 excludes one representation only.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there another product structure or perturbative description?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exact stationary laws computed for listed C_5 rates (Table 5).

limitationTriage.limitation: Mistaken reading of the cycle result at w = 1 (odd cycles lie outside the colouring hypothesis).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is every scope statement restricted to w >= 2 where needed?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Abstract, C3, Section 5 and Discussion checked after re-review.

limitationTriage.limitation: Finite certificates could be unfaithful to Definition 2.2.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do independent descriptions agree on small graphs?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Full state graph, simulated orientation digraph and Lemma 3.3 compared on all graphs with at most 6 vertices; separate engine written by the re-reviewer; semantic negative controls.

limitationTriage.limitation: Multiplicity behaviour on cycles is checked only for listed vectors.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does every multiplicity >= 2 remove the high classes on cycles?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Listed vectors on C_5, C_7, C_9 (Table 4).
